translation:
[Here begins Shri Saheli ||5||. Every verse carries the refrain "saheldi re" - "O dear friend".]

1. Let us sing of that Supreme Self - O dear friend - the great One, the treasury of all virtues. ||1||
2. By remembrance of His Name - O dear friend - the soul is released from this world. ||2||
3. In whatever manner He holds His own being - O dear friend - in that same way He holds the life-breath [of all]. ||3||
4. The purpose for which You set all this in motion - O dear friend - You alone, the all-knowing, know it. ||4||
5. With ease You created Brahma the ordainer and Shiva - O dear friend - gods and men are hardly worth the mention. ||5||
6. He who is the support of all - O dear friend - how could we ever let go of such a Father? ||6||
7. Wounded, the soul cries out - O dear friend - listen, Supreme Self, O Father. ||7||
8. I was made to leave Your nearness - O dear friend - what was my offence? ||8||
9. Why was the happiness of home forgotten - O dear friend - why was I lost here in this forest? ||9||
10. How long have I been tormented - O dear friend - at the hands of the enemies, lust and its kin. ||10||
11. In this forest the wildfire of greed is burning - O dear friend - and Death the hunter roams here at his sport. ||11||
12. Maya (illusion) was let loose as the decoy doe - O dear friend - and the net of karma was spread. ||12||
13. Caught in the net I am now helpless - O dear friend - the soul, infatuated, has lost its senses. ||13||
14. It has no memory of what went before or comes after - O dear friend - it has no awareness of its own self. ||14||
15. Gods and men writhe in that net - O dear friend - all who have been given bodies. ||15||
16. While it is still forming, [the body] is cut off - O dear friend - broken in the womb itself. ||16||
17. Take a body, and the happiness you obtain - O dear friend - is [like] scalding oil being pressed out. ||17||
18. One never points to one's own fault - O dear friend - the fault that lies within oneself. ||18||
19. Time devours [us] daily, bit by bit - O dear friend - and still the self does not wake. ||19||
20. Into such great sorrow have I been cast - O dear friend - now take care of me, Father. ||20||
21. By the Name break [the round of] this body - O dear friend - by remembrance remove its corruptions. ||21||
22. Make what is Yours like Yourself - O dear friend - take me now, delay no longer. ||22||

[Thus ends Shri Saheli, complete ||5||]
